E8_denominators.certified_fraction: certified_rows / all E8 rows, including unscoreable rows
E8_denominators.saved_call_fraction: sum of reused feeding-step slots / (2 * all E8 rows); nominal slots include fail-fast missing calls
E8_denominators.scoreable_rows: all E8 rows minus unscoreable rows

certificate_boundary: cert_eq enumerates valid value classes of the fixed deterministic consumer. Invalid fresh outputs are unscoreable; no deployment guarantee or oracle-provided runtime certificate is asserted.
